content.comment_body: Hello, I'm experiencing the same issue. Can anyone assist with restoring the .lsc file from an inaccessible .snp file? Thank you.
Unfortunately, your file appears to be corrupted. You should open a support ticket; perhaps [company_name] support can assist you.

This may be a delayed reply, but it could help someone in the future. Try opening the file using a file compression tool, as these files are compressed and you might find the .lsc file inside (that's how it worked for me with a .mnp file). Apologies for any language mistakes.

analysis.insight_summary: Users are experiencing difficulty recovering or accessing .lsc files from corrupted .snp files. One user verifies file corruption, while another suggests using a file compressor to extract recovery files. There isn't an integrated product feature from [company_name] for straightforward restoration or repair of corrupted network project files.
